summary: Tag input where Enter or comma adds a chip and Backspace twice removes the last; duplicates shake and removed tags break into pixels.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial tags when uncontrolled. A form reset restores them.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field, linked to the input.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Shown as "+ name" buttons under the field; clicking one adds it.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of tags. Adding beyond it shakes the field and shows a message.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the tags submit joined with commas.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the field and disables the input, the remove buttons and the suggestion buttons.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when tags are added (Enter, comma, a suggestion or a paste) or removed. A paste that adds several tags reports once.

keyboard.action: Add the typed text as a tag.
First press marks the last tag; a second press removes it.

accessibility: A native `<input>` labelled by a `<label htmlFor>`.
Each chip's remove button has an `aria-label` of "Remove" followed by the tag.
The counter ("2 of 6 tags") and the limit message describe the input (`aria-describedby`) and are in an `aria-live="polite"` region.
A tag marked by the first Backspace is announced through a visually hidden `role="status"`, for example "design selected. Press Backspace again to remove it."
Chips are plain elements without a list role. Removing one returns focus to the input. The pixel canvas is `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion chips appear without scaling in or a pixel spray, removed chips vanish without breaking into pixels and the duplicate and limit shakes are skipped.
form: With `name`, a hidden input submits the tags joined with commas. There is no validity check; `max` is enforced by refusing new tags. Form reset restores `defaultValue`, clears the typed text and calls `onValueChange` when that changes the tags.
notes: Tags are trimmed and inner whitespace is collapsed; case-insensitive duplicates are refused.
Pasting text that contains commas adds each part as a tag.
A long tag is truncated with an ellipsis inside its chip.
The pixel canvas reaches 20 px past the field on the left, top and bottom but not on the right, so it never widens the page.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.default: Add a tag and press Enter
